title: Umthwalo Owazisa Ukuphiliswa
intro: Umphefumlo owawuvavanywe ngendlela engaphaya komlinganiselo wawuhluthwe intuthuzelo, amaqabane, namandla omzimba. Ehlala yedwa kwiintlungu ezinzulu, lo mkhonzi ka-Allah wajika waya kuThixo kuphela. Ngomonde ongagungqiyo nomthandazo osuka entliziyweni, kwafika umsinga wenceba owadlula konke okwakulindelwe. Ngubani lo mntu ozinikeleyo wavula ucango lokubuyiselwa?
clues: Ndandingumkhonzi othandekayo ka-Allah, ndinandipha ubutyebi, ikhaya elichumayo, nempilo entle ngemihla yam.
Emva koko kwavela uvavanyo: ubutyebi bamkile, abathandekayo bamkile, nenyama yam yabethwa yintlungu enkulu.
Abo babekufutshane nam babengenakukwazi ukunyamezela imeko yam, ndaza ndashiywa ndedwa, umzimba wam uzele ziintlungu.
Ndabiza iNkosi yam, ndisithi uSathana undichukumisile ngokudinwa nokuhlwaywa.
Impendulo yeza — umyalelo wokuba ndibethe umhlaba ngonyawo lwam, kwaye kuwo kwaphuma amanzi abandayo ukuze ndiphiliswe.
INkosi yam isuse ubunzima ngokupheleleyo yaza yandibuyisela usapho lwam, lwanda, njengophawu lwenceba kwabo bacingayo.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
